# Appendices {#sec-appendix}

## Reproducibility Notes

This ASAR report is built from source files in:

- `r ebs_dir`
- `r asar_root`

Key input files used in this build are listed below.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bridge-input-files
#| tbl-cap: "Key source files used in this ASAR report build."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
if (!exists("ebs_dir") || is.null(ebs_dir) || !nzchar(ebs_dir)) {
  ebs_dir <- Sys.getenv("ASAR_EBS_DIR", unset = "/Users/jim/_mymods/noaa-afsc/ebs_pollock")
}
if (!exists("asar_root") || is.null(asar_root) || !nzchar(asar_root)) {
  asar_root <- normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), ".."), mustWork = FALSE)
}
input_files <- c(
  file.path(ebs_dir, "runs", "lastyr", "pm.rep"),
  file.path(ebs_dir, "runs", "lastyr", "pm.par"),
  file.path(ebs_dir, "runs", "lastyr", "F40_t.rep"),
  file.path(ebs_dir, "compares.qs"),
  file.path(getwd(), "std_output_admb.rda")
)

dplyr::tibble(
  file = input_files,
  exists = file.exists(input_files),
  modified_time = ifelse(
    file.exists(input_files),
    as.character(file.info(input_files)$mtime),
    NA_character_
  )
)
```

## Model Equations (Base Assessment)

The base EBS pollock assessment is a statistical age-structured model in which catch, population dynamics, and recruitment are estimated jointly [@fournier1982general; @methot1990; @ianelli1998].

$$
\begin{aligned}
C_{t,a} &= \frac{F_{t,a}}{Z_{t,a}}\left(1-e^{-Z_{t,a}}\right)N_{t,a}, \\
Z_{t,a} &= F_{t,a}+M_{t,a}, \\
N_{t+1,a+1} &= N_{t,a}e^{-Z_{t,a}} \quad (a=1,\ldots,A-1), \\
N_{t+1,A} &= N_{t,A-1}e^{-Z_{t,A-1}}+N_{t,A}e^{-Z_{t,A}}, \\
B_t &= \sum_{a=1}^{A} w_{t,a}\phi_aN_{t,a}, \\
R_t &= f(B_{t-1})e^{\varepsilon_t}, \quad \varepsilon_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_R^2).
\end{aligned}
$$

Fishing mortality is represented with age-specific selectivity and annual deviations:

$$
F_{t,a}=s_{t,a}\exp(\bar f+\epsilon_t), \quad \epsilon_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_F^2),
$$

with annual smoothness/temporal-variation penalties applied to selectivity trajectories in the ADMB implementation.

## Application of VAST to Bottom Trawl Survey Results

Bottom trawl survey (BTS) biomass is spatially standardized using a VAST delta-model framework [@thorson2018b; @oleary2021; @oleary2022]. For each observation $y_i$ at location $s_i$ and year $t_i$:

$$
\Pr(y_i>0)=\operatorname{logit}^{-1}\!\left(\eta_i^{(1)}\right),
$$
$$
y_i \mid y_i>0 \sim \operatorname{Gamma}(\mu_i,\kappa), \quad \log(\mu_i)=\eta_i^{(2)},
$$
$$
\eta^{(k)}(s,t)=\beta_t^{(k)}+\omega^{(k)}(s)+\epsilon^{(k)}(s,t)+X(s,t)\gamma^{(k)},
$$
$$
\epsilon^{(k)}(s,t)=\rho^{(k)}\epsilon^{(k)}(s,t-1)+\xi^{(k)}(s,t).
$$

The annual biomass index is obtained by summing predicted density over extrapolation-grid cells:

$$
I_t=\sum_{g=1}^{G} A_g\,\widehat{D}_{g,t},
$$

where $A_g$ is area of cell $g$, and $\widehat{D}_{g,t}$ is predicted density.

For this ASAR-native report, VAST-standardized BTS results are integrated as a survey index spanning `r start_year`-`r end_year` and compared with other model data streams in the base assessment.

```{r}
#| label: fig-vast-bts-appendix
#| fig-cap: "VAST-standardized EBS bottom trawl survey biomass index used in the ASAR-native workflow."
#| fig-alt: "Time series plot of VAST-standardized bottom trawl survey biomass index for EBS pollock."
#| echo: false
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figures_dir, "Vast_index_updated.png"))
```

## Figure and Table Packaging Notes

ASAR uses packaged `.rda` objects for programmatic inclusion:

1. Tables require `table` and `cap` fields (caption text may also be stored as `caption`).
2. Figures require `figure`, `cap`, and (for accessibility) `alt_text`.
3. Existing static figures can be included directly as PNG/JPG with explicit captions.
